source: ../nevir-plain/12_五种实战情况的原理细分与练习规格.md

legend.M: 已有明示有限模型，仅支持局部比较
legend.F: 已有实体牌/账本事实，不能当完整策略
legend.D: 现阶段仅设计或有条件方向，未取得该能力的完整比较练习

units.label: 差牌能付钱
units.prerequisite: 先能比较五张，分清当前池和新增投入
units.firstOperation: 先点出较差而愿意跟的一组，再移动它支付的钱
units.gap: 补匹配真实范围、后续与完整动作菜单
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 领先但可能被反超
units.prerequisite: 先分当前领先与未来可能反超
units.firstOperation: 点出会反超的实际跑牌，再比较退出或继续
units.gap: 已有17帧局部保护跟练；仍缺完整目标策略、撤提示迁移和真人结果
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 落后但能赶走赢家
units.prerequisite: 先会当前胜负及弃牌/被跟互斥收益
units.firstOperation: 先指出本来赢自己且会退出的候选
units.gap: 有限河牌模型不能代表所有前街诈唬
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 当前弱但能改善
units.prerequisite: 先区别后门、直接听牌与干净补张
units.firstOperation: 分别点出过牌、被跟、被加后还保留什么机会
units.gap: 已有17帧主动弱牌局部跟练；仍缺完整目标策略、撤提示迁移和真人结果
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 有摊牌赢面，但下注未必增收
units.prerequisite: 先会过牌基点与当前摊牌强弱
units.firstOperation: 同一手比较差牌付款还是全部退出
units.gap: A72 KQ仅补一条课程规则，仍缺跨情境完整策略
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 强牌考虑先过牌
units.prerequisite: 先明白先行动过牌仍可能面对下注
units.firstOperation: 固定强牌，比较直接下注与诱发弱牌投入
units.gap: 已有河牌强牌有限树，仍缺前街风险及匹配目标策略
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 暂无合算进攻
units.prerequisite: 先列完整被比较菜单与不投入基点
units.firstOperation: 把所有候选分支合起来看是否值得继续投入
units.gap: 补更广的牌力和后续；未取得参考的动作不能自动排除
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 同目的，不同尺寸
units.prerequisite: 先会一个尺寸与过牌的互斥收益
units.firstOperation: 只改金额及对应响应，再比较差额
units.gap: 4095权重模型不是4095个真实策略节点
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 能赢一部分正常取值牌
units.prerequisite: 先知道下注范围中谁是取值、自己能赢谁
units.firstOperation: 把可赢价值与可赢诈唬分开，再比较跟和加
units.gap: 三条9能赢77/AK而输KK的有限比较已补，仍缺完整范围与其他情境
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 主要只能赢诈唬
units.prerequisite: 先能摆对待补与跟后池，找可赢下注牌
units.firstOperation: 固定价格改变诈唬份量，再固定范围改价格
units.gap: 补更多价格与匹配下注参考，不能从牌型推诈唬比例
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 目前落后，但有可靠改善
units.prerequisite: 先会补张、失效补张和当前价格
units.firstOperation: 先看成花仍输，再打开未来承压分支
units.gap: 有限44张跑牌比较尚不覆盖所有听牌和未来菜单
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 既有当前赢面，又有改善
units.prerequisite: 先保留当前赢面和未来改善两个字段
units.firstOperation: 点当前可赢与当前落后两组，合并去重后的终局份额，再比较全下跟弃
units.gap: 已有Jd7d给定转牌全下模型和14帧局部跟练；仍缺非全下未来菜单、目标范围及独立迁移
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 加注让差牌多付钱
units.prerequisite: 先会价格及加注后的弃/跟/再加
units.firstOperation: 固定强牌，看差牌跟加与只继续下注的差异
units.gap: 已补受限价值树而非借听花模型，仍需匹配参考及更广菜单
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 加注希望赶走更好牌
units.prerequisite: 先识别更好牌及加注后所有回应
units.firstOperation: 只改对加注的弃牌分支，重新比较
units.gap: 模型只覆盖给定半诈唬树，不自动适用小注或任意人群
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 继续没有足够收益
units.prerequisite: 先会弃牌未来增量为零及其他选择
units.firstOperation: 把跟/加所有后续计完，允许直接弃牌
units.gap: 须接匹配防守参考，不把一个模型的弃牌推广
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 算清新价格
units.prerequisite: 先分已下、加到与还需补
units.firstOperation: 在原筹码上摆出新的待补与跟后池
units.gap: 还需覆盖其他金额与合法再加状态，价格本身不定策略
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 原价值牌面对强加注范围
units.prerequisite: 先把原下注范围切换为加注范围
units.firstOperation: 保留原差牌付款者作对照，再看谁真正加注
units.gap: 已补KK/77加注比例变化的三条9比较，真实加注范围与其他牌力仍缺
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 听牌被加注
units.prerequisite: 先会听牌真实胜出与新价格
units.firstOperation: 把再加后的未来和剩余投入重新展开
units.gap: 既有AsQs分支仍属一套限制树，其他尺寸和组合待补
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 再加可以多收钱
units.prerequisite: 先能比较跟注与再加的完整回应
units.firstOperation: 看更差牌是否仍付钱，是否失去后续诈唬
units.gap: 已补77继续或弃牌的受限再加比较，仍缺完整目标策略
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 再加用于诈唬
units.prerequisite: 先看新的弃牌目标与有利/不利移除
units.firstOperation: 分别点被移除的继续牌与弃牌，再算整条再加线
units.gap: 已有21帧局部跟练和给定再加区间比较；仍缺目标匹配范围、真实响应与独立迁移
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 后手与合法动作变化
units.prerequisite: 先读本街投入、有效后手和行动是否重开
units.firstOperation: 只点合法菜单；区分自己全下仍待回应
units.gap: 14卡不等于通用规则引擎，不足额全下等完整边界待实现验证
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 对手跟我的下注
units.prerequisite: 先有原范围及该次跟注的依据
units.firstOperation: 按实际响应留下候选，保留慢打可能
units.gap: 作者给定回应可复算，仍缺匹配真实逐手响应
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 双方过牌
units.prerequisite: 先区别过牌与弃牌，知道谁还行动
units.firstOperation: 不删除所有弱牌，按有依据的过牌概率更新
units.gap: 不能由一次过牌推演模型中的具体百分比
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 我的下注范围不同
units.prerequisite: 先明白自己范围与当前实体手牌不同
units.firstOperation: 两边分别保留实际走该线的候选
units.gap: 已有两版合法联合配对和实际手牌条件化；仍缺完整双方范围与真实响应
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 前面尺寸或路线不同
units.prerequisite: 先保留真实历史及相应响应
units.firstOperation: 同牌钱换历史，重新筛选并比较
units.gap: 有限同价异序例不覆盖所有尺寸/加注路线
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 账本与行动顺序更新
units.prerequisite: 先会当前投入和本街关闭条件
units.firstOperation: 筹码进池、后手减少、移动行动者
units.gap: 固定脚本正确不等于通用金额引擎和界面通过
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 结果不倒推上步正确性
units.prerequisite: 先看到动作前的完整可能分支
units.firstOperation: 并排比较决策前EV与某一次赢输，不倒推
units.gap: 已有四条答后示例与动作前判断分离，仍缺真人理解与陌生迁移验证
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 自己改善
units.prerequisite: 先会最佳五张与当前改善
units.firstOperation: 只亮出新加入最佳五张的实体牌
units.gap: 自己的成牌改善不等于策略或相对权益必改善
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 对手留下的牌改善
units.prerequisite: 先继承前序候选，再处理新牌
units.firstOperation: 只在实际留下的候选里看改善
units.gap: 明示模型不是目标玩家后验或全部后街参考
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 听牌完成或新增
units.prerequisite: 先区分直接听牌、成牌与补成仍输
units.firstOperation: 分别点成顺/成花者及仍在听者
units.gap: 相关源路线花色有绑定差异，不能搬用精确动作
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 公共牌配对
units.prerequisite: 先会三条、葫芦、四条与共享公共牌
units.firstOperation: 公共牌成对后重新拼五张
units.gap: 需匹配真实候选与响应才能判断行动
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 来更高牌
units.prerequisite: 先能对双方具体底牌重新配对
units.firstOperation: 同一高牌让某组降级、另一组配到
units.gap: 不能生成高牌必利于进攻方的规则
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 看似空白
units.prerequisite: 先知道空白是相对哪些候选而言
units.firstOperation: 先指出没变的关系，再带回历史与价格
units.gap: 同最终牌钱模型仅作历史机制对照，不是通用空白牌策略
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 新牌移除组合
units.prerequisite: 先区别实体冲突与行动筛选
units.firstOperation: 含新牌的组合划除，其余继承权重
units.gap: 不把物理删除自动称为确定策略或任意后验
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

units.label: 到河牌，未来机会结束
units.prerequisite: 先确认是河牌且仍可能有行动
units.firstOperation: 关闭未来补牌理由，转向当前胜负与付款/退出
units.gap: 同花移除例不补全河牌所有动作参考
units.returnRule: Return to the same current decision snapshot; update tasks return to the resulting legal next state.

limitations: Prerequisites are supplied or taught inside the current decision, not a compulsory pre-course checklist.
Labels describe local materials, not complete teaching sequences, heldout transfer or target-policy coverage.
All35 target and learner checks remain unverified; no app or learner records changed.
